posts.title: Is Memento Mori Futile?
posts.description: On graduating from law school, Ivan Ilyich outfits himself with fashionable clothes and a medallion inscribed respice finem : consider the end. Then he dines at a first-class restaurant. Decades later, dying in agony, he finally asks whether he has lived wrongly. What troubles me is that he already had the warning: he wore it. posts.title: Ten months of Alloy: local where it counts
posts.description: I started Alloy almost a year ago as a model-agnostic AI chat app, so that my conversations would live in plaintext files I control. It has since become my AI chat app of choice. I use it daily on my laptop and on my phone as a PWA. posts.title: Outsourcing to the Gods
posts.description: I listened to Troy rather than reading it, which is how I imagine Homer's audience would have received the story: one performer, many voices, and a long recitation. Fry isn't improvising in hexameter; he's reading his own text word-for-word.
